name: Intiornis
sum: Small avisaurid enantiornithean from the Campanian Las Curtiembres Formation of northwestern Argentina.
holotype: A partial hindlimb (number in Novas et al. 2010).
biology: Long toes of equal length and large curved claws suggest a perching or grasping foot.
author: Novas et al. 2010
